name: AFR 9939 刹车问题 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 939, a flight from Wuhan to Beijing, you are parking at gate 07, you have received information H, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 939，从武汉飞往北京，停在07号登机口，已收到通播H，向武汉放行申请空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 9939, gate 07, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 9939，07号登机口，通播H，申请前往北京的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: AFR 939, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 18, ZF-02 departure, initial climb 2700 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 939，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，离场使用 Runway 18，执行 ZF-02 离场，初始爬升至 2700 米，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 127.35，应答机 2615。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 18, ZF-02 departure, initial climb 2700, request level change en route, departure frequency 127.35, squawk 2615, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，离场使用 Runway 18，执行 ZF-02 离场，初始爬升至 2700，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 127.35，应答机 2615，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for pushback and startup, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 939, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 939，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 939, push back and start up approved, facing east.
B: Tell the controller you have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, you want to change the push back position in face west.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，可以推出和开车，机头向东。告诉管制员，强顺风下发动机启动有困难，希望改为机头向西的推出位置。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, but we have difficulty in starting the engines with strong tailwind, request change the push back position in face west, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，但强顺风下发动机启动有困难，申请改为机头向西推出，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: Now you have completed pushback and startup procedures, you are ready for taxi, request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已完成推出和开车程序，准备滑行，请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 939, pushback and startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 939，推出和开车已完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, taxi to holding point Runway 18 via taxiway Z4, A and A1.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 18 via taxiway Z4, A and A1, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道Z4、A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, hold at present position, give way to Airbus 320 vacating via E5.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，在当前位置等待，让行经E5脱离的Airbus 320。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, traffic in sight, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当前位置等待，看到冲突飞机，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 939, traffic is clear, continue taxi via A and A1 to holding point Runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 939，冲突已解除，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A and A1 to holding point Runway 18, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经A和A1滑行至18跑道等待点，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point A1, Runway 18, you have completed pre-takeoff checklist, you are ready for takeoff, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在A1等待点、18跑道，起飞前检查单已完成，准备好起飞，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 9939, holding point A1, Runway 18, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 9939，A1等待点，18跑道，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: AFR 939, cleared for takeoff Runway 18, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 939，许可从 Runway 18 起飞，地面静风。

cards.audioText: During takeoff roll, you notice an Airbus 3 20 is crossing your runway, you aborted takeoff, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞滑跑期间，你注意到一架 Airbus 320 正在穿越跑道，你中断了起飞，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 9939, we aborted takeoff due an Airbus 320 crossing Runway 18.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 9939，因一架 Airbus 320 正在穿越 Runway 18，我们中断了起飞。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 939, what is the situation like now?
B: Tell the controller your brakes have exceeded the temperature limit, and request taxi back to apron to have the plane checked.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 939，现在情况如何？
告诉管制员刹车已超过温度限制，并申请滑回机坪检查飞机。
cards.referenceText: Our brakes are overheating, request taxi back to apron for check, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们刹车过热，申请滑回机坪检查，AFR 9939。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 939, do you need any assistance?
B: Tell the controller you need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 939，你需要任何协助吗？
告诉管制员需要客梯车让旅客下机。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we need stair vehicle to disembark the passengers, AFR 9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 需要，我们需要客梯车让旅客下机，AFR 9939。
